pieces.Text: If you have performed your daily obedience, your skin is as thick and tough as that of a dwarf who's worked the forge for 50 years, every scratch and burn associated with the memory of a masterpiece you've realized in stone or steel. As a free action, you can toughen your skin further, gaining DR 10/chaotic and evil. Dismissing this ability is also a free action. This ability lasts
rounds per day. The rounds don't need to be consecutive.
